description: A schema compiler that generates fast bit-packed serialization code from one definition, for C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Java, JavaScript, Dart, Elixir, Lua, Luau and more. Game network packets, save files and cooked assets. A better alternative to Protocol Buffers and FlatBuffers.
